Video download checks

Hover a loaded video, including a paused one. Its download button appears at the top right. Click it to save video and audio to Downloads. The toolbar’s Downloads button keeps progress and cancellation available when you navigate away.

1. Direct MP4 with audio

Download twice: both files must play with sound and have different filenames. Try keyboard focus and player fullscreen.

2. Complete video blob

The original MP4 is exposed through an object URL. It must save as a normal playable file.

3. Transparent feed cover

Transparent clickable cover

The download button must save this video without opening the cover’s link.

4. Clipped player

Scroll inside this player: the button stays inside its visible area.

5. Dynamic player

A newly inserted video should receive a download button.

6. Embedded player

Download feedback must reach the frame. Also test this page in both halves of a split tab.

Additional live checks: Instagram posts/Reels, YouTube watch pages/Shorts, navigation during downloading, and cancelling a large download.
